author: assistant_visual_review
purpose: Evaluation-only reference intervals; never passed to the annotator or written to formal stage labels
limitations: Visual judgments from original agentview and wrist observations, not simulator ground truth; uncertain boundaries remain intervals

recordings.task: place the black bowl on the flat stove

events.name: grasp_and_lift
events.note: Gripper engages the patterned-interior bowl; by the later frames it moves with the gripper away from its initial table position. Exact support separation is occluded. Independent visual recheck widened the upper bound from 80 to 100; the interval is uncertainty about completion time, not a claim that every included frame is already lifted.

events.name: supported_placement_and_release
events.note: Bowl is at the stove earlier; gripper withdraws and separates from the supported bowl over this interval. Environment done is not the release label.

recordings.note: Reviewed whole-trajectory coarse samples and finer local images around the two events; no observed drop, not proof that no brief event exists between inspected frames.

recordings.task: place the black bowl on the flat stove
recordings.note: The target patterned-interior bowl remains on the table. The gripper approaches a different dark object near the stove. No target grasp/lift or target placement completion observed.

recordings.task: place the yellow bowl in the bottom drawer of the white cabinet and close the drawer

events.name: grasp_and_lift
events.note: Gripper engages the yellow bowl and it moves with the hand toward the drawer. Lift-off is partly occluded; independent visual recheck widened the upper bound from 408 to 432. This is uncertainty about completion time, not a claim that initial contact equals lift-off.

events.name: supported_placement_and_release
events.note: Bowl is inside the open drawer; the gripper opens/withdraws while the bowl remains supported in the drawer.

events.name: drawer_closed_after_placement
events.note: Drawer front moves into the cabinet and the visible gap closes; boundary judged from images, not copied from the environment success index.

recordings.note: Reviewed full recording at coarse intervals and denser local images after freezing the current design; the task occurred in older development rounds, so this is not a historically unseen task. No confirmed regression in inspected images; unsampled brief events remain unverified.
